judge_relevance_hypotheses.summary: A reader meets one block per official task, with the dollar figure inside the first task's block; this says nothing about how the paper was judged.
The memorandum restates the strategy as imperatives with reasons. Its readability is separate from the truth of the 13-times figure.

weaknesses.summary: Equation (8) is written with the gold price only. Bitcoin's MAPE of 0.041630 appears in the summary and has no displayed formula. The skill may teach a loss written once and applied to each series. It must not teach a formula that names one series as the measure for two.

The printed statistic divides by 9 and sums 10 terms, which is the sample standard deviation, while the mean beside it divides by 10. The two denominators disagree and neither is explained. The skill must not present the pair as a clean definition without stating the split.

In Table 3 the bold minimum of every column equals 0.007261552 and sits on the initial value. The scan never selects a value other than the start. The skill may teach one-at-a-time tuning. It must not teach this scan as evidence that a search found an optimum.

Figure 4 shows the two curves nearly overlapping and shows nothing else: no baseline forecast, no error bar, no holdout split. Overlap can support shape agreement. It cannot support the word proven. The skill must not use a curve overlay as a proof of forecast quality.

Figure 7 plots log of value. Table 4 puts the ideal strategy's annualized return at 1406.66 percent and ours at 266.36 percent, and the log axis compresses that gap so the two curves finish close. The caption never says the axis is logarithmic. The skill may use a log axis for series with very different ranges. It must say so in the caption and must not read closeness on a log axis as closeness in level.

Figure 8 draws a normal curve over five histograms. Four of them are spikes at zero and only bitcoin spreads out. The sentence under the figure says all five follow a normal distribution. The skill must not cite a normality figure that contradicts four of its own panels.

Table 6 prints profits 10874.24, 14325.13, 13069.35, 14587.49, 10865.78. The largest is at 3 percent, not at the lowest commission, and the endpoints differ by 8.46. The win rate dips at 3 percent. The skill may summarize a noisy column. It must not say remains the same of a column that moves by thousands.
Table 8 prints win rates 0.4583, 0.381, 0.2745, 0.2954, 0.303. The series falls for three steps and rises for two. The skill must describe the turn, not only the first half.

The table defines both f and o as the output function of the forget gate, and defines i as the input function of the forget gate. Equations (2), (3) and (6) use f, i and o as three different gates. The skill must take the equations as the definition and treat the table as contradicted.

The body proves the forecast only by the curve overlay warned above, so the word accurate in the letter has no stated test behind it. The summary says the profit exceeds 13 times, the result section says more than 13 times, and the letter says about 13 times, while 14325.13 divided by 1000 is 14.3. The skill may restate a result more loosely for a non-specialist reader. It must not let the looser sentence say a different number, and it must not carry a proof word the body never earned.

unresolved_questions: Equation (8) names only the gold price, while the summary quotes a bitcoin MAPE of 0.041630 with no formula.
The risk statistic divides by 9 and sums 10 terms, while the mean beside it divides by 10.

The gold missing-value fill averages the neighboring days, including the next day, and the paper does not say whether a filled value is used before that day.
14325.13 divided by 1000 is 14.3, against the summary's exceeds 13 times, the result section's more than 13 times and the memorandum's about 13 times.
